budget_items.topic: Q1 revenues and expenditures against budget
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Revenues were 27.2% of what is expected and expenditures were 36.4% after the first quarter, described as typical.
budget_items.quote: revenues came in at 27.2% of what is expected and expenditures came in at 36.4%.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Motor vehicle excise collections were 7% higher than last year.
budget_items.quote: motor vehicle excise collections were 7% higher than last year.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Local options meal tax collection was 41% higher than expected; the receipts are collected by the state and then awarded to the town.
budget_items.quote: local options meal tax collection was 41% higher than expected.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Real estate tax collected was 4% higher than last year.
budget_items.quote: real estate tax collected was 4% higher than last year.

budget_items.topic: Net metering credits, Chase Road Solar project
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Net metering credits collected on the Chase Road Solar project were $16,795.00.
budget_items.quote: net metering credits collected were $16,795.00 on the chase road solar project.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Assessors calculated the new growth estimate at $261,802.
budget_items.quote: new growth estimate was calculated by the assessors at $261,802.

budget_items.topic: Personal property tax from solar projects
budget_items.what_was_recorded: $77,000 of the new growth is coming from personal property tax related to the two solar projects.
budget_items.quote: $77,000 of that is coming from personal property tax and is related to the two solar projects.

budget_items.topic: Police lockup and radio watch salary appropriation
budget_items.what_was_recorded: One third of the lockup appropriation has been spent; the town is looking at regional opportunities and has a part-time desk officer to avoid overtime.
budget_items.quote: we have spent 1/3 of the appropriation for lockup.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Tree removal was over expended by $6000 due to the July microburst, with no state or federal reimbursement expected; the Finance Committee has been advised.
budget_items.quote: tree removal was over expended by $6000 due to the microburst in july.
